newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dransfield hits high on placement plan.
newsitem.headline: Dransfield hits high on placement plan.

text.p: Shares of consumer electronic goods and appliances marketer Dransfield Holdings Ltd rose HK$0.115 or 24.21 percent to hit a year high of HK$0.59 in late morning after the company announced a share placement plan.
"Speculation that market makers might try to boost the price before the deal fueled demand by short term speculators," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.

Dransfield said earlier it planned to raise HK$27.4 million through a share placement and subscription of new shares at HK$0.465 per share with proceeds to cut debt and to strengthen its capital base. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
